references.text: The parallel account of Aaron's death on Mount Hor, where Moses and Eleazar accompany him up the mountain, and Aaron dies after his priestly garments are transferred to his son Eleazar.
Confirms that Aaron died at Moserah (another name for the area near Mount Hor) and that his son Eleazar became priest in his place.
Moses is told that he will die on the mountain, just as Aaron died on Mount Hor, and will be gathered to his people.
The explanation of why Aaron was not allowed to enter the Promised Land – he disobeyed the Lord's command at the waters of Meribah.
The preceding verse which states that the Israelites broke camp from Kadesh and encamped at Mount Hor on the border of Edom's land.
The reference to the exodus from Egypt, which forms the basis for the time indication 'in the fortieth year' in this verse.
